comment: Which pigeon is which, and which of them fly on this lake. Authored by hand, like
tools/decor_sets.json: assets/pigeons.json is the mechanical cut of the sheet and
nothing in those rectangles says which standing bird belongs to which flying one.
The sheet is laid out by action, not by bird. A row's first block is one bird's
three-frame flap. Its second and third blocks are three DIFFERENT birds standing
and sitting -- birds 1-3 on row 1, 4-6 on row 2, 7-9 on row 3 (rows 4-6 repeat
them). So bird N's poses live on row (N-1)/3+1 at frame (N-1)%3, never on N's own
row. Reading the standing frames off the flying bird's row is what made a perched
pigeon change colour every 0.42 s, and is why this file exists.
`use` is the pick: three birds, by decision (2026-09-16). Pick from
tools/pigeon_contact.gd's picture and flip the flags -- do not delete a bird.
